content.text: {"narrative":[{"claim":"UNICEF's total income from voluntary contributions was $9.326 billion in 2022, flagged as a watch item, compared with $8.920 billion in 2023 and $8.263 billion in 2024.","cites":["kpi:222","kpi:223","kpi:216"]},{"claim":"UNICEF's Core Resources income in 2024 was $1.584 billion, which was 46% of total income.","cites":["kpi:211","kpi:217"]},{"claim":"UNICEF's 2024 Core Resources income comprised $724.9 million from the private sector, $512.6 million from the public sector and $346.1 million from other partners.","cites":["kpi:213","kpi:212","kpi:214"]},{"claim":"In 2024 Other Resources Regular made up 49% of UNICEF's total income and Other Resources Emergency made up 5%.","cites":["kpi:218","kpi:219"]},{"claim":"In India in 2024, safely managed water supplies were provided to 59.3 million people and sanitation services to 17.9 million people.","cites":["kpi:232","kpi:233"]}]}
